Claudia Cristina is a professional dancer, choreographer, teacher, and model based in Montreal, with more than 15 years of experience in dance, performing arts, entertainment, and fashion.

A graduate of the National Ballet School of Cuba, she was part of the Cuban National Ballet for over six years and also performed with Les Grands Ballets Canadiens de Montréal. Throughout her career, she has participated in internationally recognized productions and appeared on prestigious stages.

In addition to her artistic career, Claudia has extensive experience as a dance teacher for children and adults through schools, community programs, and private classes.

Claudia is also a professional model and was crowned Miss Canada Latina in 2021. She has collaborated with various fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands in Montreal and internationally, bringing elegance, professionalism, and stage presence to every project.

Today she continues to share her passion for movement, creativity, and artistic expression through every performance, collaboration, and experience she creates.
